title: Technical Program Manager Intern
searchText: Technical Program Manager Intern  Nuro Who We Are Nuro is a self-driving technology company on a mission to make autonomy accessible to all. Founded in 2016, Nuro is building the world’s most scalable driver, combining cutting-edge AI with automotive-grade hardware. Nuro licenses its core technology, the Nuro Driver™, to support a wide range of applications, from robotaxis and commercial fleets to personally owned vehicles. With technology proven over years of self-driving deployments, Nuro gives the automakers and mobility platforms a clear path to AVs at commercial scale, empowering a safer, richer, and more connected future. About the Role Our software organization is growing and we are looking for talented students to join our Technical Program Manager (TPM) as part of the Pathfinders Internship Program. As a Pathfinder, you will gain meaningful work experience while applying the knowledge and skills you have gained in the classroom. You will have the opportunity to make connections with interns and employees across the company and to make a quantifiable impact on one of our teams. We hire students at the undergraduate and graduate levels for roles lasting 12, 14, or 16 weeks. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to help Nuro deliver complex and strategic multi-functional software engineering projects. About the Work Act as the internal “glue” by communicating and coordinating across all teams, including software and hardware engineering, product, operations, and business, to drive multiple complex, cross-functional initiatives related to remote monitoring and operation. Lead technical reviews, synthesize results, and build plans to resolve product issues. Develop requirements, define timelines/milestones, identify/mitigate risks, allocate resources, track progress, resolve dependencies, unblock progress, etc. Regularly communicate progress to company leadership and program partners. About You You are pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, mechanical, electrical, or aerospace engineering, and/or equivalent technical experience/aptitude, graduating August 2026 - 2027. You are passionate about becoming a technical program and/or project manager and about gaining experience bringing complex software products to market. You collaborate well with others and take pride in helping teams succeed. You are keenly discerning with an ability to prioritize and execute on multiple concurrent tasks. You have the DNA to thrive in the ambiguity of a dynamic, start-up environment . You have a real passion for helping drive the delivery of creative products leveraging AI, robotics and/or machine learning. Bonus Points Prior experience in robotics, autonomous systems, or safety-critical applications. For this position, the reasonably expected base is $8,000. Your actual base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. At Nuro, we celebrate differences and are committed to a diverse workplace that fosters inclusion and psychological safety for all employees. Nuro is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and expressly prohibits any form of workplace discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. #LI-DNP Who We Are Nuro is a self-driving technology company on a mission to make autonomy accessible to all.
